segs: THE ‘EVERY STUDENT’ (ESC)MEDIA STRATEGY
MARILYN ADAMSON
ESC Media broadly conveys an evangelistic message to
the entire campus, using posters, campus newspaper
ads, and evangelistic articles.
WHAT TO EXPECT
Most students on campus will see your posters and
ads. Campuses who use the campaigns say there is
tremendous value in getting these messages out on
campus, to soften the ground, to cause them to think
about God. And because the campaign is visible all
over campus, it’s easy to offer students the free article.
You can broadly hand out articles and in personal
conversations. For Christian students who have never
shared their faith, it’s pretty easy to say, “Have you
seen these posters on campus? Would you like a free
copy of the article?” Many students are very willing to
read an article, even more easily than they will engage
in a conversation. And every article contains a clear
presentation of the gospel, written within the context
of the topic.
ESC MEDIA STRATEGY
There are 17 different ESC campaigns available, on
a wide variety of topics. The posters/ads can all be
freely downloaded, or you can order a set of all the ads
in the campaign as printed slicks.
E V E RYS T U D E N T M E D I A S T R AT EGY 1
Simply take the downloads or printed slicks to a
nearby Kinko’s and photocopy them for use on
campus.
“A POSTER A WEEK” STRATEGY
Here’s a a simple yet powerful poster campaign
strategy you can try on your campus. The strategy
is to put up a different poster from the ESC Media
Campaign each week providing you a consistent
presence on campus throughout the year.
Each of the posters/ads offer a free evangelistic
article, corresponding to that topic. You can put your
own email address or phone number on the posters/
ads (before you make copies), and deliver the article
to students who request one. You will also want to
order a large supply of the articles to hand-out on
campus and quantities for Christian students on your
campus to use in personal evangelism.
Students will see a variety of compelling messages
throughout the school year. Every poster points them
to an article on EveryStudent.com
This strategy can be a great conversation starter,
making it easier for you to talk to students on campus
about the Gospel message.
Even if students do not contact you, each ad promotes
an evangelistic website Everystudent.com.
There are several different posters for each campaign.
